scope: Six final generic CLI replays of three previously preserved, unchanged S60 SGS builds. Aiolos movement and isolated numeric-5 sports interventions are compared with idle at equal fixed virtual deadlines. Original SGS interpreter only; no SIS/native APP execution, no new-title discovery claim.

aiolos-fighter-s60.title: Aiolos Fighter (S60)
aiolos-fighter-s60.evidence: Active Mission 1 vertical-shooter field. RIGHT (17) moves the player fighter from the centre toward the right while the time-matched idle fighter remains near the centre; LEFT (16) is also delivered. No mission completion is claimed.
